_meta.note: VERIFIED per-model architecture for precise RAM/KV-cache estimation (33-agent investigation, 2026-06-27). Drives fit.py + the precomputed `resource` block in open-models.json. attn: gqa|mha|mla|hybrid; KV uses n_kv_heads*head_dim (GQA-correct), kv_per_layer for MLA, kv_layers for hybrid Mamba, sliding_window caps KV ctx.

bge-m3.note: 567M, ~1.1GB weights fp16. Multilingual+multi-vector (dense/sparse/colbert) adds modest activation overhead. CPU-only practical; 8GB RAM laptop is min machine.

llama-embed-nemotron-8b.note: Llama-3.1-8B backbone (~7.5B params actual, bidirectional). ~15GB weights fp16 -> needs 16-24GB GPU (4090/A5000/L4). q8 ~7.5GB (12-16GB GPU), q4 ~4GB (8GB GPU or 16GB Apple Silicon). CPU runs but too slow for volume; batch strongly preferred to amortize.

mxbai-embed-large.note: 335M, 0.67GB weights fp16. BERT-large encoder, no KV cache. Comfortable CPU-only; any 8GB laptop.

nomic-embed-text-v1.5.note: 137M params, 0.27GB weights fp16. Encoder, no KV cache. Trivial CPU-only on any laptop; GPU unnecessary. Single or batch both fine.

nv-embedcode-7b.note: ~7B multimodal (LLaVA-style, text+image). ~14GB fp16 + image-encoder/pixel buffers push runtime higher -> 16-24GB GPU at fp16, ~7GB q8, ~4GB q4 (8GB GPU). Image preproc favors batching. CPU not practical.

snowflake-arctic-embed2.note: 568M, ~1.1GB weights fp16. Same class as bge-m3. CPU-only fine; batch improves throughput, single-doc OK on laptop.

stable-diffusion-3.5-medium.note: 2.5B MMDiT + VAE (~0.08B) + 3 text encoders (CLIP-L 0.12B, CLIP-G 0.69B, T5-XXL 4.7B) + latent/attention buffers. Full fp16 ~16GB; Stability quotes 9.9GB GPU with text encoders offloaded/fp8; fp8/q4 paths reach ~6GB. 8GB GPU is realistic floor, 12GB comfortable. CPU diffusion impractically slow (minutes/image). Batching multiplies latent memory; single-image default.

whisper-large-v3.note: 1.55B encoder-decoder ASR. ~3.1GB weights, ~3.4GB fp16 inference (the ~10GB figure is heavy-batch production). int8 ~1.5GB. CPU-only genuinely practical via faster-whisper/whisper.cpp int8 (~1h audio in ~6 min CPU, ~10-20x slower than GPU). Min: 8GB laptop CPU or any 4GB GPU. Batch for throughput, single-stream fine.
